research_result.description: GoHighLevel is a marketing automation and CRM platform offering REST APIs, AI Agent Studio APIs, and a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing contacts, messaging, calendars, opportunities, and workflows.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can generate Private Integration Tokens directly within HighLevel account settings for single-location or internal tools, or register an app in the Developer Marketplace to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret for OAuth 2.0 authorization flows. API access is tied to HighLevel account plans (Starter, Unlimited, or Agency Pro).

evidence.claim: GoHighLevel supports OAuth 2.0 for public integrations and Marketplace apps.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: HighLevel supports: - Private Integration Tokens for internal or single-location integrations - OAuth 2.0 for public integrations and Marketplace apps requiring user authorization

evidence.claim: GoHighLevel supports Private Integration Tokens as a replacement for legacy API keys.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Private Integration Tokens (PIT) are the recommended replacement for legacy API keys because they provide more secure and flexible access management.

evidence.claim: GoHighLevel APIs accept OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens in the Authorization header.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Public APIs use OAuth 2.0 bearer tokens.

evidence.claim: GoHighLevel provides REST endpoints across CRM and marketing resources.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Our API includes REST endpoints for contacts, messaging, workflows, calendars, payments, webhooks, and more.

evidence.claim: GoHighLevel hosts an official MCP server for connecting AI agents to its services.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The HighLevel MCP Server lets AI agents and MCP-compatible clients connect securely to HighLevel tools and services.

evidence.claim: API access level depends on HighLevel subscription plans.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Basic API access is included with our Starter and Unlimited plans, while Advanced API access is available on our Agency Pro plan.
